comment:
* A sink that keeps a buffer internally so that callers can do small writes
 * without a performance penalty.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: Buffer buffer()
methods.comment: Returns this sink's internal buffer.

methods.name: BufferedSink write(byte[] source) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Like {@link OutputStream#write(byte[])}, this writes a complete byte array to
   * this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink write(byte[] source, int offset, int byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Like {@link OutputStream#write(byte[], int, int)}, this writes {@code byteCount}
   * bytes of {@code source}, starting at {@code offset}.

methods.name: long writeAll(Source source) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes all bytes from {@code source} and appends them to this sink. Returns the
   * number of bytes read which will be 0 if {@code source} is exhausted.

methods.name: BufferedSink write(Source source, long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes {@code byteCount} bytes from {@code source} and appends them to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeUtf8(String string) throws IOException
methods.comment: Encodes {@code string} in UTF-8 and writes it to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeUtf8(String string, int beginIndex, int endIndex) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Encodes the characters at {@code beginIndex} up to {@code endIndex} from {@code string} in
   * UTF-8 and writes it to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeUtf8CodePoint(int codePoint) throws IOException
methods.comment: Encodes {@code codePoint} in UTF-8 and writes it to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeString(String string, Charset charset) throws IOException
methods.comment: Encodes {@code string} in {@code charset} and writes it to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeString(String string, int beginIndex, int endIndex, Charset charset) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Encodes the characters at {@code beginIndex} up to {@code endIndex} from {@code string} in
   * {@code charset} and writes it to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeByte(int b) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a byte to this sink.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeShort(int s) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a big-endian short to this sink using two bytes.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeShortLe(int s) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a little-endian short to this sink using two bytes.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeInt(int i) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a big-endian int to this sink using four bytes.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeIntLe(int i) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a little-endian int to this sink using four bytes.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeLong(long v) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a big-endian long to this sink using eight bytes.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeLongLe(long v) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a little-endian long to this sink using eight bytes.

methods.name: BufferedSink writeDecimalLong(long v) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a long to this sink in signed decimal form (i.e., as a string in base 10).

methods.name: BufferedSink writeHexadecimalUnsignedLong(long v) throws IOException
methods.comment: Writes a long to this sink in hexadecimal form (i.e., as a string in base 16).

methods.name: BufferedSink emitCompleteSegments() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Writes complete segments to the underlying sink, if one exists. Like {@link #flush}, but
   * weaker. Use this to limit the memory held in the buffer to a single segment.

methods.name: BufferedSink emit() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Writes all buffered data to the underlying sink, if one exists. Like {@link #flush}, but
   * weaker. Call this before this buffered sink goes out of scope so that its data can reach its
   * destination.

methods.name: OutputStream outputStream()
methods.comment: Returns an output stream that writes to this sink.

methodNames: BufferedSink write(byte[] source, int offset, int byteCount) throws IOException
BufferedSink write(Source source, long byteCount) throws IOException
BufferedSink writeUtf8(String string, int beginIndex, int endIndex) throws IOException
BufferedSink writeString(String string, Charset charset) throws IOException
BufferedSink writeString(String string, int beginIndex, int endIndex, Charset charset) throws IOException
